question: What does the supreme bestow upon one born from mantra?
premises: parāparāmantramamukātmana = of self born from supreme-inferior mantra
inference: The supreme makes the one born from mantra an enjoyer of supreme-inferior enjoyment.
uncertainties: compound segmentation and syntax are uncertain
plain_english: Thus, of one born from the self of supreme-inferior mantra, I make supreme-inferior enjoyment-enjoyership.
